searchText: It asks you to calculate the basefee. Old version of geth doesn't support it and expects currentBaseFee in env.json You can ask retesteth to calculate basefee if tool doesn't support it using flag in config "calculateBasefee" : true, But there must be parentBaseFee in the env Which version of geth you use?
